snippet.title: PSX Longplay [552] GaiaSeed: Project Seed Trap
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: NPI

An easy shooter even on hard mode. The energy bar keeps refilling, and the bullets hurt you only if they hit dead center. The game is in Japanese but dubbed in English, if you can understand what the guy in the cutscenes is talking about.

When fighting the level boss, you can either kill them or let the time runs out. This changes the game ending depending of what you do with the last two 

bosses. To get the good ending (which is the ending in the main longplay at 29:07) you have to let the time run out for both of them. I added the bad 

endings that you get if you kill them:

33:36 Beat first final boss
37:00 Beat second final boss -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
